item.title: Sálim Ali Day 2026 – 130th Birth Anniversary Celebration, Thrissur
item.description:
🐦 The Sálim Ali Foundation celebrates the 130th birth anniversary of Dr Sálim Ali, the “Birdman of India”, with the Sálim Ali Memorial Lecture and a presentation challenge for college students.

📆 Date: Thursday, 12 November 2026

⏰ Time: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM

⛳ Venue: C. Achuthamenon Study and Research Centre Auditorium, Costford, Ayyanthol, Thrissur

Sálim Ali Memorial Lecture

10:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Speaker: Padma Shri M. Chandradathan, Space Scientist and former Director, Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC)

Topic: Sustainable Development

PPT Presentation Challenge for College Students

2:00 PM – 4:00 PM

Topic: Birds after Sálim Ali

Programme Schedule

Time Programme Duration
10:00 AM Registration and tea
10:30 AM Welcome Address – Dr. Lalitha Vijayan, Honorary Director, Sálim Ali Foundation 10 min
10:40 AM Presidential Address – Dr. V. S. Vijayan, Chairman, Sálim Ali Foundation 10 min
10:50 – 11:05 AM Inaugural Address – Dr. T. V. Sajeev, Chief Scientist, KFRI 15 min
11:05 – 11:45 AM Felicitations – Dr. V. P. Prasad, Rtd. Joint Director, BSI 10 min
Dr. P. S. Easa, Rtd. Director, KFRI 10 min
Shri. V. K. Sasikumar, Rtd. Professor, Engineering College, Thrissur 10 min
Mr. Manoj Karingamadathil, Coordinator, Wiki Loves Birds Project, Sahya Digital Conservation Foundation 10 min
11:45 AM – 12:30 PM Sálim Ali Memorial Lecture – Padma Shri M. Chandradathan, Space Scientist and former Director, Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre 45 min
12:40 – 12:50 PM Vote of Thanks – Pavithra A., Assistant Director, Sálim Ali Foundation
1:00 – 2:00 PM Lunch break
2:00 PM PPT Presentation Challenge – “Birds After Sálim Ali”

Organisers

Organised by: Sálim Ali Foundation, Kanimangalam, Thrissur 680027

With: Sahya Digital Conservation Foundation, Wikimedia Foundation, Wiki Loves Birds India
